name: Ringo Corponation Tandem Fold Microvan
description: The Tandem Fold Microvan is Ringo Corponation's answer to GLMZ's chronic spatial scarcity — a compact urban transport vehicle built around a collapsible chassis system that allows the vehicle to compress its width and length by approximately 40% when parked or navigating narrow corridors. The compression mechanism, called the Tandem Fold System, uses a series of interlocking structural ribs and pneumatic sleeve joints to physically reconfigure the vehicle's profile without compromising the passenger or cargo compartment integrity. In its collapsed state, the Microvan occupies roughly the footprint of a large motorcycle.
tactical_use: The Microvan's ubiquity is its greatest tactical asset — it blends seamlessly into urban traffic and draws no attention from enforcement or corporate security. Operatives use it as a surveillance vehicle, a mobile staging platform, and a getaway vehicle that can squeeze through alley junctions that would stop a conventional car. The cargo configuration has been used to transport everything from medical supplies to bound prisoners. Its collapsible profile also makes it uniquely suited to rooftop transport, stacked parking facilities, and the compressed transit tunnels that connect certain mid-district blocks.
cultural_context: The Tandem Fold Microvan is the everyman vehicle of GLMZ — seen everywhere from corporate campus lots to outer-district street markets. It carries no prestige and considerable practicality, which has made it quietly beloved by working residents and quietly contemptuous to the city's upper tiers. Some outer-district communities have developed a culture of extensively modifying Fold Vans into rolling homes, medical clinics, and workshops, given their spatial flexibility. The vehicle appears in dozens of Vantablack Media productions as shorthand for ordinary, struggling urban life.
known_users: Small business operators and delivery workers
story_hooks: A Ringo Corponation delivery fleet of Fold Vans has been rerouted by a firmware update — every van in the district is now converging on the same address, and nobody at Ringo will admit to pushing the update.
A crew's reliable Microvan has been fitted with a hidden compartment by a previous owner — and that compartment contains something the previous owner clearly died trying to hide.

An outer-district community has converted twelve Fold Vans into a mobile neighborhood — a rolling settlement that uses the vans' collapse function to pack into defensible configurations at night — and someone with real estate interests wants them gone.
A seemingly ordinary Fold Courier delivery van is running a route that doesn't correspond to any registered business — but it makes the same stops, at the same times, every single day.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, wedge-shaped urban microvan with an aggressive forward rake and flush, aerodynamic surfaces. In standard mode, it presents a compact sedan-like silhouette; in collapsed state, it becomes a narrow, elongated form factor resembling a high-tech motorcycle with an enclosed cabin. The Tandem Fold System's mechanical nature is visually evident — visible interlocking structural ribs along the sides create a segmented, modular appearance.
physical_description.dimensions: Standard: 410cm L × 180cm W × 155cm H; Collapsed: 250cm L × 110cm W × 155cm H. Vehicle-scale, fits standard parking spaces in compressed mode.
physical_description.weight_description: Approximately 1,200 kg; heavy enough to require powered steering and braking, light enough for single-charge efficiency across GLMZ distances.
physical_description.primary_material: Aluminum alloy chassis with carbon-fiber composite body panels. Pneumatic sleeve joints use reinforced elastomer.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal-gray primary with brushed aluminum accent strips along the fold seams. Surfaces treated with anti-reflective coating to minimize corporate surveillance detection.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray (#2F3437) body with chrome-silver fold mechanisms and accent stripping. Optional tier 1 corporate livery packages available in deep blue or midnight black.
physical_description.interface_elements: Centralized 12-inch holographic heads-up display mounted above steering yoke; physical emergency collapse/deploy lever (red anodized aluminum) on driver's right knee panel; capacitive touch pad for tertiary controls; dual USB-C ports for auxiliary systems; pneumatic pressure gauge visible on lower left flank.
distinctive_features: Visible interlocking structural ribs that shift position during compression — creates a rippling, organic motion during fold/unfold cycle
Pneumatic sleeve joints glow faintly blue when system is pressurized (nitrogen-based indicator dye)
Recessed LED light strip that runs the length of both flanks, angles dynamically during turns
Transparent polycarbonate side panels on rear cargo section revealing folded seat mechanisms
Modular snap-point anchors visible across interior frame for aftermarket augmentation mounting
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Ringo Corporation's interlocked-ring logo (Φ-stamped) on driver-side lower panel in raised chrome; 'TANDEM FOLD SYSTEM™' laser-etched along right shoulder line; regulatory compliance stamps (GLMZ Urban Vehicle Authority, split-axle certification) on rear bumper in white reflective text.
physical_description.condition_typical: In urban deployment, typically observed in compressed state in tight parking corridors and narrow side streets; occasional street-market presence where drivers expand to full width for short-haul cargo missions. Light surface wear accumulates in salt-spray zones near Great Lakes access routes; pneumatic joint seals show minor dust accumulation requiring seasonal maintenance.
